authority.canonicalSource: This manifest defines logical hook roles and contracts. Harness files are replaceable projections, never policy authorities.

rootPolicy.discovery: Resolve from the adapter module URL; rendered Codex commands use git rev-parse --show-toplevel from the session cwd.

hooks.inputContract: Harness-native JSON is normalized into tool name, tool input, cwd, and logical PreToolUse event.
hooks.outputContract: Allow emits nothing. Deny emits the harness-native structured block result.

exitContract.runtimeDefect: Never exit 1; evaluator defects become a structured deny with exit 0.

hooks.cwdPolicy: The adapter resolves imports from its own module URL; provider commands must be root-anchored.
hooks.protectedScope: May classify protected path names from hook input; never reads protected contents.
hooks.teardown: Remove only the generated provider projection; shared policy sources remain registered.

providerAdapters.command: OMP HookAPI imports the shared YURI policy and URL cores from the worktree root.

hooks.inputContract: Pass the harness prompt-event JSON unchanged to October's generated bus hook.
hooks.outputContract: Forward successful October context output; timeout, absence, or transport failure emits nothing.

exitContract.runtimeDefect: Never exit 1; this context/telemetry hook is fail-soft.

hooks.cwdPolicy: YURI wrapper resolves its own worktree root and invokes the external October generator output with a bounded deadline.
hooks.protectedScope: Does not inspect protected runtime or secrets; transports the current prompt event to the local October bus.
hooks.teardown: Remove only the generated provider projection. Never edit ~/.october/bus-hook.mjs by hand.

legacyInventory.rule: Do not rehydrate the historical provider-specific hook theater as the universal authority. Migrate still-needed logical behavior explicitly into this registry.
May delegate to the universal adapter; project activation should invoke the universal adapter with a worktree-rooted command.
October owns the current lifecycle commands. The YURI registry may render a bounded UserPromptSubmit overlay but must not redefine October endpoints.

The current adapter is live but only routes exact lowercase bash calls through shared YURI cores. It is not universal parity or a logical-role authority; migrate it only through the separately approved live-activation gate.
Preserve additive/idempotent user-setting merge behavior; migrate its YURI source input to registry rendering in a separately reviewed installer change.
The S1-to-S2 test validates the universal manifest and adapter, not sparse-absent historical Claude hook files.
October owns and regenerates this file. YURI may bound it but must not hand-edit it.
